others.title: BioWare 可能已经消失，但它的精神在这些游戏中继续存在

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/23/bioware-lives-on-blogroll-1792774338672.jpg

BioWare was shut down by EA earlier this week . While the studio had struggled through a long stretch without putting out a genuine classic, it’s no lie to say it was behind some of the best RPGs of all time . At its peak, with games like Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , Mass Effect and Dragon Age: Origins , BioWare was a pioneer of not only building worlds, but filling those worlds with characters I (and so many others) actually cared about.

But BioWare went so much further than just writing some witty dialog and calling it a day. I always think back to the Mass Effect 2’s climactic suicide mission, where, unless you’ve completed all of your companions’ loyalty quests and built up those relationships, there was a real chance they would just die, never to return in the trilogy’s final chapter. BioWare built personal, heartbreaking consequences into its stories.

The games BioWare made in its heyday were incredibly influential, but I don’t think there are any games from other developers that tried to build on those successes that truly hit the same level. Even BioWare struggled to capture that same magic in its latter games. But while I don’t think there is anything out there close to the ultimate quality of the Mass Effect trilogy or the first three Dragon Age games, the spirit of BioWare’s best work does live on in the work of the games they inspired.

Just in the last few years, there have been plenty of games that draw straight from BioWare’s well, and there are quite a few projects in the works, including two that look like they could just be new BioWare games. So if you’re hunting for more BioWare in the wake of this terrible news, here are six games to keep in mind.
Baldur’s Gate 3

Now, obviously BioWare made the first two Baldur’s Gate games, so of course they had a massive influence on the third one. But each time I go back to Larian’s Baldur’s Gate 3 , the influence from Mass Effect and Dragon Age becomes more obvious. The way it introduces your companions and encourages you to build close relationships, for example, is extremely BioWare.

That’s not to mention the complicated web of different romance options in the game. I ended up wooing Lae’Zel, and spent hours building her into a reliable tank to carry me through the late game. And then I made a really bad decision involving a mind flayer, and she just straight up left my party for good. I had to figure out how to adjust my party (and my broken heart) from there.

Earlier in that playthrough, I ended up accidentally killing a potential companion, just because of some choices I made when trying to help some fellow paladins in Act One. It wasn’t until my next playthrough that I even realized they were someone I could recruit, and when I did realize it, I felt awful. In many ways, this chain of action and consequence mirrors what I love so much about Mass Effect 2’s suicide mission, but in Baldur’s Gate 3, it spans the entire game.

Even outside your little web of companions, the choices you make are core to what makes Baldur’s Gate 3 tick. From the outset, the game throws seriously consequential decisions your way that can come back to bite you in the ass depending on what you choose to do with them. Early on, there’s a commune of druids that are having a spat with some visiting Tieflings, and the way you handle that doesn’t just affect the scenario, but begins a domino effect that extends through the whole campaign. There are some pretty dark ways that situation can play out, too, and that’s just one of the dozens of encounters you have to deal with that shapes your character and playthrough.
The Outer Worlds

Most of the time, The Outer Worlds feels like Fallout: New Vegas in space. That’s a pretty natural conclusion, considering it’s developed by New Vegas studio Obsidian Entertainment. But just like Baldur’s Gate 3, The Outer Worlds frequently feels exactly like a BioWare game, thanks to the way it handles its six companions. No matter how many wild situations the game puts you through, the thing that always sticks with me when I go back to The Outer Worlds is how fleshed out the companions are.

All of them have their own distinct needs, leading to side quest chains that will ultimately decide their fate. And, similar to both Mass Effect and Dragon Age’s decision-tallying finales, there’s an entire tree of different endings that change depending on the choices you make. A lot of the questlines that dictate those endings cross over each other too, creating this tangled web of possibilities that can potentially make every playthrough just a little bit different.
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered

CD Projekt Red and BioWare go way back, with the original Witcher game being built on the same engine as Neverwinter Nights . So, it’s not surprising that The Witcher games have carried the spirit of BioWare’s approach to storytelling for years. And that feels a little weird to say, because when I think of BioWare, I think of RPGs with a protagonist that you create yourself, and companions that surround you for the entire course of the game – two things The Witcher doesn’t have. In all of the Witcher games you play as Geralt of Rivia and, occasionally, other characters from the books, and the allies you gather aren’t party companions in the BioWare sense of the word.

I go back and forth with myself all the time over which of these games I love the most, but The Witcher 3 is probably the best example of CDPR taking BioWare’s legacy and running with it. You spend most of your time in The Witcher 3 on your own, trying to find Geralt’s adoptive daughter, Ciri. But even though you are by yourself most of the time, there’s a huge focus on doing side missions for supporting characters to build up allegiances ahead of when – spoilers – the villainous Wild Hunt attacks your fortress home of Kaer Morhen. Right off the bat, that leaves a lot of potential for an ending reminiscent of Mass Effect 2’s iconic final mission, but unfortunately not a lot happens if you fail to recruit friends to help defend the Witcher fortress.

Still, The Witcher 3 is a game I’ve played through four or five times, and even though I know there’s not much of a gameplay purpose to recruiting everyone, I still try to get all my friends into that castle in the mountains, even if it just means unlocking dialog that makes me feel warm and fuzzy.
Exodus

It’s no secret that for the last decade or so, even before EA shuttered BioWare, things were rough for the studio. A lot of talented people jumped ship, especially in the run-up to Anthem. One of the studios that formed from these talented ex-BioWare folks is Archetype Entertainment, and its first game, Exodus , is due out on April 7 next year.

We’ve actually got the chance to play a bit of Exodus early, and from what I’ve seen and read from my colleagues, it looks as much like a new Mass Effect game as yesterday’s leaked trailer. It’s a squad-based sci-fi RPG, and one of your squadmates is an octopus in a giant mech. That sounds ridiculous, and it is, but just look at the wild and wonderful companions we got in Mass Effect. In the trailer we got at Gamescom, there were scenes that made it look like we’re going to meet their family. So, it at least seems like there’s going to be some suitably wild companion quests in the game.

items.title: 因德·纳瓦雷特在《X战警》首秀前揭秘罗刹女口音片段

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20261024/ItIAcwbufvfDmip.png!a-3-480x.png
Inde Navarrette 在一段新视频中展示了她为小淘气（Rogue）准备的口音，模仿了这位《X战警》英雄标志性的口头禅“sugah”，但她表示如果粉丝们不喜欢，她愿意“继续改进”。
作为已确认出演漫威电影宇宙（MCU）《X战警》重启电影的众多明星之一，Navarrette 向粉丝们展示了大家期待已久的重大揭秘：她对小淘气口音的诠释。在上个月 TIFF 2026 期间接受 Etalk 采访时，当被要求透露一些细节时，她只说了一句“sugah”。
这位因《着迷》（Obsession）走红的演员坦言，在准备小淘气这个角色时，她还没有“进行大量的练习”，但看起来她至少已经花了一些时间将这个极具辨识度的词汇融入到她的表演中。
小淘气以其时尚感和吸收能力的超能力而闻名，但粉丝们最熟悉的可能还是她的口音。随着 Navarrette 确认将在 2028 年《X战警》加入 MCU 时饰演这位出生于密西西比州的变种人，粉丝们一直渴望听到她的声音——而她也深知这一点。
今年 9 月，她向小淘气的粉丝们保证，她正在努力工作，最重要的是要掌握那种南方口音。她计划的一部分包括在未来某个时候去密西西比州旅行，当时她说“南方女性真的是我的最爱”。她还继续表示，她正在“尽一切人为可能”来还原小淘气，因为她“热爱那个角色”。
小淘气此前曾以动画和真人形式出现过，但她在 MCU 中的亮相可能是迄今为止最重要的塑造。Navarrette 非常清楚她和她的出身对粉丝意味着什么，所以如果你不喜欢她上个月展示的那句简短的“sugah”，她承诺会与漫威影业一起解决这些问题。
“我知道，如果你们不喜欢，我会继续改进，”她说，“我会弄清楚并与漫威团队沟通我们想要的效果。”
在经历了数月的魔形女（Mystique）传闻后，Navarrette 在 8 月的 D23 特别发布会上被正式确认为小淘气的扮演者。与她一同确定的还有其他多位演员，包括饰演 X 教授的 Christopher Abbott 和饰演暴风女（Storm）的 Maya Boyd。不久之后，Asa Germann 也被选为天使（Angel）的扮演者。
《X战警》将于 2028 年 5 月 5 日上映，届时将在大银幕上重新构思经典的漫威超级英雄。在此之前，你可以了解小淘气的动画配音演员 Lenore Zann 对 Navarrette 选角的反应。你还可以阅读导演 Jake Schreier 在创作该项目时所参考的漫画故事。

content.v: 日前，“影视飓风”创始人Tim（潘天鸿）在抖音直播期间，与“飓风男装”（李四维）连麦时，突然遭遇平台封禁。
直播过程中，两人原本还在正常交流，连麦却突然中断。对此，李四维当场表示：“它把影视飓风直接ban掉了，为什么？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241223032868.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241223046293.png
从封禁提示来看，平台给出的原因是“涉及色情低俗内容”。然而，直播画面和两人的对话似乎并未涉及相关内容，这一突发状况也让李四维和直播间观众感到十分困惑。他甚至抓着头连连追问：“哪句话呀？”面对这次突如其来的封禁，显得既无奈又有些哭笑不得。
随后，李四维还开玩笑称，如果影视飓风主账号被封禁的时间太长，那可就有意思了，万一影响到双十一期间的直播，事情就更尴尬了。

items.summary: 据大河报报道，“外卖小哥闪婚娶美国女博士宣布离婚”一事引发关注。

content.v: 据大河报报道，“外卖小哥闪婚娶美国女博士宣布离婚”一事引发关注。记者联系到刘浩，他表示，妻子大自己3岁，二人没有孩子，目前相关资料已经准备好了，等下个月汉娜休息的时候，她会来到抚顺，在抚顺办理离婚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261024_zy_red_164_5/1105.jpg
“这两年，我们在沈阳工作，东北环境太冷。她来自美国南方，待不适应。所以我就想给她换一个工作，到杭州可能适应一点。一个月前，我们大约9月底到了杭州。到杭州后，开始出现一些小矛盾和争吵。但我们俩语言不通，争吵要用手机翻译，翻译不明白。我说的话，翻译过去不是那么回事，她翻译给我也不是那么回事，比较乱。”
刘浩表示，除了语言不通，两人在饮食、生长环境、爱好等方面都有各种差异。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261024_zy_red_164_5/1294.jpg
“我们刚开始是真有爱情，在爱情的力量下，可以无限包容对方。但是随着时间的改变，我的英语没有进步，她的中文也没有进步。语言不通可以用手语沟通，但很多问题叠加在一起就非常困难。跨国婚姻不是大家想那么简单的。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261024_zy_red_164_5/1399.jpg
刘浩表示，他现在已经回到了东北，打算在老家发展，汉娜则在杭州工作。“离婚以后，可能明年她就会辞掉工作回美国。她在这边每天上班八九个小时，觉得太累了。其实我们感情一直很好。除了工作累她也想家，很多美国的软件在中国用不了，她也很苦恼。语言不通的情况下，不光跟我，跟身边的同事、朋友，也没有办法聊天，她很孤独。”

content.v: 据MP1st外媒报道，动视旗下新工作室Elsewhere正在开发一款开放世界游戏，重点将放在“涌现式玩法”（Emergent Gameplay）上。该工作室据称汇集了来自CD Projekt RED、顽皮狗等知名开发团队的资深从业者，目前仍在为这一项目扩充人手。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241137507657.png
Elsewhere近期发布了一则“助理动画总监（动态世界）”的招聘信息。职位描述称，受聘者将负责制定并推动游戏动态世界的动画设计方向，打造可信、具有反馈性且令人印象深刻的体验，让游戏世界更加鲜活。相关工作需要与动画、设计、工程、美术、音频和叙事等多个团队合作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241138048842.png
所谓“涌现式玩法”，是指游戏中的系统能够自然产生开发者未必预先编排的有趣情境。玩家可以自由探索世界、与各种角色互动，并通过游戏机制触发不同的事件，而不是始终按照固定脚本推进。
《孤岛惊魂》《GTA》以及《潜行者》系列都包含这类玩法。《荒野大镖客2》同样是典型案例。游戏开放世界中的狩猎、探索等活动可能引发意料之外的遭遇。

content.v: 抖音推进清朗整治短视频虚假人设乱象专项行动，集中清理摆拍造假、编造人设博流量的账号，10月1日到10月22日已经处置违规账号2万余个，清理违规视频4.7万余条。
这次专项行动划定五类重点打击对象。包括假扮弱势群体骗取关注、虚构职业资质发布专业内容、利用AI仿冒人物虚假营销、鼓吹奢靡迷信引流牟利、编造冲突剧情博取流量。
很多普通用户很容易被这类故事打动，看着视频里的悲惨遭遇，就愿意点赞打赏、下单买东西。实际上背后大多是团队写好完整剧本，目的就是流量和带货。虚假人设不光消耗大众善意，虚构的专业内容还会误导普通人，带来财产损失。
平台方面表示，后续还会持续巡查这类乱象，同时开放用户举报通道，普通人刷到疑似摆拍造假的内容，可以直接提交举报。平台也提醒创作者，尽量做真实内容，不要靠编造故事博眼球。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792811876_100563.jpg
平台放出几批典型查处案例：
案例一：账号“桂*”虚构“朋友在电机事故中离世”的社会事件，吸引流量，经平台核查，相关信息属编造，相关账号及内容已被依规处置。
案例二：账号“宇*”发布摆拍救助流浪汉的视频博取关注，经平台核查，视频中当事人系被雇佣出镜，并非真实流浪汉，相关账号及内容已被依规处置。
案例三：有矩阵账号利用“小海”AI形象进行卖惨带货，经平台核查，相关人物系AI合成数字人，相关账号及内容已被依规处置。
案例四：账号“爷*”发布摆拍“爷爷生病仍独自抚养孙女”的视频进行卖惨博同情，经平台核查，相关信息系编造，相关账号及内容已被依规处置。

content.v: BioWare关停、《质量效应5》项目取消的决定引发广泛不满，项目总监迈克·甘布尔近日发文，感谢玩家们源源不断的支持与声援。
甘布尔在推特上表示，大家的支持让团队深受触动，同时他也呼吁正在招人的企业关注自己的组员。他称团队里全是“元老级核心成员”，似乎是怕有人质疑，打造出BioWare多款 经典 大作的核心人才如今仍留在工作室。
他写道：“我刷多久都看不完大家的留言，满是对工作室的支持、对BioWare品牌遗产的认可，还有对它带给大家的影响的感念。这对我们来说意义重大。这支元老团队人才济济，如果大家知道有合适的岗位，欢迎推荐。我愿意为我团队里的每一个人亲自担保。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792811698_533257.jpg
甘布尔不想让发言停留在沉重的氛围里，在结尾还开了句玩笑调节情绪。
“至少以后《GTA 6》发售，我不用再打电话请病假翘班了。”
本周早些时候有消息曝出，EA被沙特公共投资基金牵头的私人投资集团收购后，将启动400人的裁员计划。
遗憾的是，BioWare也受此次风波波及，工作室直接宣告关停，《质量效应5》的开发工作全部终止。业内众多开发者都对此表示惋惜，参与过《质量效应5》开发的人员也称，这款作品“本会是很特别的存在”。
从后续泄露的内容来看，它确实独具亮点。消息曝出后不久，就有预告片的相关传闻流出，随后《质量效应5》的完整预告片果真在网上泄露。想想它本该呈现的模样，实在令人唏嘘。

items.title: Switch2惨遭纯软件越狱！独占游戏要在PC上运行了？
items.summary: Switch 2首个纯软件越狱出现，玩家围绕模组自由与固件封堵展开讨论。

content.v: 由你来说： 游戏主机被破解，历来是玩家社区绕不开的话题，这一次轮到了发售仅一年多的Switch 2。有人期待模组与自制软件带来的自由，也有人担心主机生态因此受损。你更关心哪一边？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的看法。
近日，安全研究者公开了名为“ns2jb”的Switch 2首个纯软件越狱方案，利用eShop在售编程软件《SmileBASIC 4》的整数溢出漏洞获得系统级权限，可运行自制程序、备份存档，还能把初音未来等非原版角色塞进《马力欧卡丁车 世界》。该越狱属于有线方式，主机重启后即失效，也不能运行盗版游戏。相关消息在Reddit等社区引发大量讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241101242824.png
有玩家认为，任天堂对自制软件和盗版问题的态度有些过度，没必要投入这么多资源打官司；大多数普通玩家不会因此放弃正版，自己用过多台破解过的老主机，如今依然选择购买正版游戏。也有玩家调侃，看到消息后的第一件事就是关闭主机的自动更新。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241101501460.png

items.title: 《鬼武者》新作难度太低？卡普空认为恰到好处很满意
items.summary: 《鬼武者：剑之道》发售以来，游戏的难度一直是玩家讨论的焦点。面对部分玩家关于游戏难度偏低的质疑，卡普空表示，公司一直在分析…

content.v: 《鬼武者：剑之道》发售以来，游戏的难度一直是玩家讨论的焦点。面对部分玩家关于游戏难度偏低的质疑，卡普空表示，公司一直在分析玩家的实际游玩数据，认为满意目前的难度设计基本达到了开发团队的预期。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241058083857.png
《鬼武者：剑之道》发售前，卡普空首次推出游戏试玩版时，关于难度是否过低的争论就已经出现。部分早期敌人站在原地、几乎没有反应的游戏片段在网上广泛传播，让不少习惯了《只狼》《仁王》或《忍者龙剑传》等动作游戏的玩家担心，本作的挑战性可能不足。
在接受PC Gamer采访时，游戏总监二瓶悟（Satoru Nihei）表示，开发团队一直在观察玩家的实际游玩数据，以了解玩家在哪些环节遇到困难，以及他们推进游戏的情况。
“我们一直在分析玩家游玩后反馈回来的数据，因此能够看到玩家在哪些地方遇到了困难，以及他们是如何推进游戏的。从目前的数据趋势来看，游戏难度基本符合我们最初的设计目标。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241058349522.png
二瓶悟进一步解释称，卡普空观察到，大多数玩家能够逐步推进剧情，但整个过程并非毫无阻碍。“玩家确实会在某些地方受挫，会死亡，也会被敌人击败。但他们能够克服这些困难，继续推进游戏。这正是我们在设计游戏难度时希望实现的效果：玩家既能够体验完整的故事，也会遇到一定挑战，并在击败敌人后获得成就感。
“我们从来没有打算把这款游戏做成你刚才提到的那些作品那样，成为一款特别困难的游戏。就我们希望达到的难度定位而言，我们认为目前已经找到了合适的平衡。”

content.v: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》里的娜薇是整个系列最具标志性的精灵伙伴。那句总在耳边念叨的“嘿，听我说”烦人又可爱，时隔多年依旧是塞尔达系列的经典记忆。然而这只小精灵的最初设定，和我们如今熟知喜爱的带翅膀发光小球截然不同——她最终呈现出这个形象，完全是受任天堂64主机的技术限制。
任天堂元老、《时之笛》设计师小泉欢晃早在2011年的“岩田问”访谈中就透露过这件事。随着即将推出的重制版让玩家重新关注起原作，YouTube频道Kit & Krysta翻出了这段旧访谈，也引起了我们的注意。试想一下，《时之笛》里林克的伙伴居然不是没有面孔的发光光球?据小泉欢晃所说，娜薇最初的设定是类人形态的角色。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792809583_516714.jpg
小泉欢晃表示：“一般来说，制作精灵角色都会做成可爱的少女形象，但任天堂64的机能做不到这一点，所以我就做成了带翅膀的光球。”
这个最初的设计方向合情合理，毕竟此前的2D塞尔达作品中，精灵都是类似小叮当的少女形象。我个人推测，类人模型的细节量太大，要塞进这么小的角色里，同时还要保证动画和AI的基本表现，在当时几乎不现实。
小泉欢晃也是《时之笛》Z锁定系统的核心设计者，这套系统没有采用传统的屏幕光标，而是以娜薇作为锁定标识。在同一场访谈中他提到，娜薇的诞生，只是因为他不想用千篇一律的普通标记。
他说：“我是设计师，不想用这么简陋的标记。我想做点不一样的东西，于是就想到了精灵。毕竟这可是《塞尔达传说》啊。”
试想一下，如果任天堂在《时之笛》重制版里把娜薇做成更写实的女性形象，感觉既好笑又有点违和。好在官方放出的实机片段已经确认，娜薇还是那个虹彩光球，只是建模更圆润了。不过想想也挺奇妙的：要是当年N64处理器的性能再强一点，娜薇的形象大概率就完全不是现在这样了。

content.v: Epic Games首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼公开批评Valve坚持要求Steam平台上架游戏必须披露AI使用情况，称这项政策“令人反感”。此前Epic已公开力挺生成式AI在游戏开发中的应用。
斯威尼表示：“强迫开发者写下这类政治声明，再被他们一手煽动的仇恨群体拿来当作攻击开发者的武器，这种做法极其恶劣。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792809182_675942.jpg
Steam的AI披露规则要求，在游戏中使用生成式AI的开发者必须明确说明AI的具体使用场景。例如《使命召唤：现代战争4》的披露内容为：“开发团队使用生成式AI工具辅助制作部分游戏内资产。”
早在2025年11月，斯威尼就开始反对游戏行业的AI披露要求，称在“未来几乎所有内容生产都会融入AI”的大趋势下，Valve的这套做法毫无逻辑。
今年6月，他更进一步表态，将Steam的AI披露要求比作“红字烙印”，坚称这会“让游戏开发者的成功之路变得无比艰难”。
斯威尼的最新言论是在回复网友马特·沃克曼的评论时发布的。沃克曼的X平台个人简介显示，他就职于生成式媒体云服务商Fal，负责“内容与用户氛围运营”。沃克曼认为，“到2026年还要求披露AI生成内容，这个前提本身就十分荒谬，对Valve和Steam来说实在难堪”，斯威尼显然对此深表认同。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792809190_874224_jpg_r.jpg
本月以来，Epic Games与斯威尼就游戏及开发领域的生成式AI话题频频高调发声。上周Epic介绍改版后的PC客户端时就调侃称：“我们的Epic游戏商城是靠氛围码出来的。”
就在昨日，Epic宣布举办一场虚幻引擎游戏创作赛——这类赛事要求参赛者在短时间内完成游戏开发。最初的赛事规则强制要求参赛者使用AI，还承诺提供无限的智能代理支持。随后Epic撤回了这一硬性要求，更新后的规则为“AI使用量完全由参赛者自行决定，多少不限”。
另一边，Steam新品节试玩展刚刚落下帷幕，本届参展的AI辅助游戏数量创下历史新高，试玩游戏总数量几乎是2026年6月新品节的两倍。一旦Steam的推荐算法生效，所有粗制滥造的AI游戏很快就跌到了榜单末尾，但大量AI作品涌入确实让游戏商店的内容变得愈发杂乱。
与此同时，还有人利用AI以创纪录的速度复刻热门游戏，爆款作品几乎一夜之间就会出现山寨版本。不少游戏开发者甚至选择取消自家试玩版的发布，只为降低被抄袭的风险。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792809198_584264_jpg_r.jpg
不出所料，斯威尼的最新言论在评论区引发了两种常见的反驳：既然AI这么好，为什么要藏着掖着?如果答案是“因为有些人讨厌AI”，那人们讨厌它的原因又是什么?
在我看来，这恰好能解释斯威尼口中那个没有明确定义的“仇恨群体”——至少他的表述很容易让人觉得，所有反对或抵触AI的人都属于这个群体。那么，人们为什么会反对游戏中的生成式AI，又为什么希望商店能明确标注AI内容?数十位开发者与行业专家都向媒体阐述过背后的缘由。

法律层面，AI相关的版权问题处处是雷区;创作层面，AI可能会掏空核心创作流程的价值;道德层面，AI服务商始终没有正面回应这项技术的环境影响，以及训练素材中大量盗用受版权保护内容的问题。更关键的是，AI行业本就以盈利困难著称，头部企业靠着虚高的估值勉强维持，这个头重脚轻的市场早已到了需要调整的地步。截至目前，这些AI企业大多只做到了冲击消费级硬件市场，搅乱了软件行业的生态，在生活成本高企的当下，破坏了人们的休闲娱乐与爱好体验。

在游戏领域，对AI的批评大多集中在美术、音乐等资产的生成上。更多开发者认可AI在编程方面的辅助作用，亚洲游戏市场对AI的接受度也普遍高于西方市场，不过全球范围内仍有不少工作室明确反对AI。但即便你认为如今的编程只是机器辅助创作——就连Valve联合创始人加布·纽维尔也持类似观点，甚至看法更激进——也不难理解人们为什么希望对AI的使用加以约束。《死锁》的开发团队也在使用AI，但有意思的是，他们并没有把AI当成整个品牌的核心卖点大肆宣传。

说白了，看看Steam更新后的AI披露条款就能明白，其中写道：“此外，游戏中的AI技术正飞速发展，我们希望能妥善处理相关问题。许多艺术家与创作者对AI的剥削性使用与滥用问题感到担忧，这完全合理。但我们也清楚，技术与工具在未来几年还会发生巨大变化，也有很多富有创造力的游戏开发者正在探索以合乎伦理的方式使用AI，打造优质的娱乐内容。如果你计划在Steam发布产品，认为我们在AI相关规则上有遗漏的重要内容，欢迎与我们沟通。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 虽然《复仇者联盟5》中仍有许多谜团尚未揭晓，这无疑是漫威电影宇宙（MCU）粉丝最想知道的问题之一，但紧随其后的其实是这部电影的整体表现。没错，粉丝们想知道哪些角色尚未公布，谁会牺牲，以及为什么小罗伯特·唐尼会饰演毁灭博士等等，但许多人更关心的问题是，《复联5》能否成为漫威电影宇宙的复兴之作。毕竟，尽管自2019年《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》为无限传奇画上句号以来，漫威电影宇宙也取得了一些巨大成功，例如今年早些时候上映的《蜘蛛侠4》，但众所周知，漫威电影宇宙在过去七年中一直在努力寻找自己的方向，而这将是自那以来的首部《复仇者联盟》电影。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792809844_988457.webp

因此， 《复联5》的成败至关重要，但到目前为止，我们还没有太多关于其最终走向的迹象。诚然，一些重要角色的回归令人兴奋，包括克里斯·埃文斯在《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》结束后令人震惊地回归饰演美国队长史蒂夫·罗杰斯，但这样的决定远不能保证电影会取得成功。不过，令人欣慰的是，关于《复联5》的最新消息表明，它或许真的能为漫威电影宇宙带来一线生机——而这对于整个漫威电影宇宙来说，无疑是朝着正确方向迈出的一大步。
根据最近的一份报告， 《复联5》上周的试映反响不错，其中一位观众甚至称赞其“远超预期”。当然，这并非官方声明，因此需要谨慎对待。但对于急需这部电影成功的漫威电影宇宙来说，这至少是一个充满希望的信号。虽然说漫威电影宇宙的未来取决于《复联5》未免有些夸张，但可以肯定的是， 《复联5》的成败将对漫威电影宇宙未来几年的发展产生深远的影响，无论好坏。
鉴于目前仍有很多人担心《复联5》可能无法像许多人期待的那样全面回归，因此，有报道称试映反响良好——甚至超出了预期——这无疑是粉丝们翘首以盼的消息。现在的问题是，这是否属实，如果属实，那么《复联5》正式上映后，广大粉丝是否也会有同样的反应。当然，总会有人不喜欢新电影，《复联5》也无法避免。即便如此，如果这份报道反映了观众对《复联5》的整体反应，那么漫威电影宇宙或许真的正在重回正轨。

content.v: 《星球大战：零号连队》的核心战术体验获得肯定，但评论认为，四人小队、重复地图以及不够突出的成长系统限制了游戏潜力。与《幽浮2》相比，本作的外围系统仍有明显扩展空间。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792809797_707368_jpg_r.jpg
评论认为，Bit Reactor已经证明《星球大战》题材能够自然融入回合制战斗。部署队员、规划走位并寻找突破困难遭遇的方法，为游戏构成了可靠基础；队员之间的关系也让小队不再只是可以随意替换的兵员集合。
队伍规模是评论重点质疑的部分。本作每次只能派出四名特工，而《幽浮2》虽然同样以四人队起步，之后却可扩充至六人。作者认为，增加两名能够完整配置的成员足以显著拓宽战术组合，现有扩大队伍的模组也反映出玩家对此存在兴趣。
地图和环境种类不足同样影响重复出勤时的变化。玩家较快便能认出相似地形与布局，难以获得《幽浮2》程序化地图带来的不确定性。此外，队员成长路线和战略升级不够突出，阵容成型后很少需要重新调整。
作者建议潜在续作加入能够实质改变决策的成长路径，并利用《星球大战》的阵营、技术和敌人行为塑造更鲜明的任务。伤势、损失及共同作战经历也可进一步影响队员关系与能力。不过，这些内容均为评论者的续作设想，并非Bit Reactor已经公布的开发计划。

content.v: 据外媒Daily Gadget报道，任天堂有望推出Switch 2的廉价版本“Switch 2 Lite”，相关传闻近日随三星新一代芯片制程的消息再度升温。目前该机型尚未获得官方确认，仍属于爆料阶段。

韩国《电子时报》称，三星晶圆代工将于12月推出名为“8LPU+”的第二代8纳米制程平台。由三星代工的Switch 2定制芯片Nvidia T239若采用该制程，预计性能提升约12%、功耗降低约15%、芯片面积缩小约8%。

content.v: 10月20日，《Arc Raiders》主播aimkey在X平台发布一段游戏操作片段，配文疑惑“我怎么还没被封号”。不少观众指出，片段中准星移动速度异常、精准度离谱，是典型的自瞄外挂特征。10月23日，他证实自己因使用自瞄外挂，已被游戏处以硬件封禁。
aimkey近日发文称：“我被《Arc Raiders》以使用自瞄外挂为由误封了。自游戏上线以来我就全身心投入其中，公开直播了数千小时的游戏内容。我愿意专程飞往Embark总部，在开发者面前现场操作，证明我完全没有作弊。我的声誉和职业生涯都因此被毁，甚至因为这次封禁收到了死亡威胁。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792808842_901756.jpg
反作弊系统确实存在误判的可能，但平心而论，提出前往总部现场操作来自证清白，并不是反驳作弊指控的有力依据。这就好比被指控偷窃的人跟警官说：“你随便拿件东西放我面前，我当着你的面肯定不偷。”
Embark客服人员艾伦在官方回复中表示：“经我方调查，已确认该账号存在持续的异常行为模式，证实存在自瞄开挂行为，违反了《服务条款》与《最终用户许可协议》第五章（行为准则）的相关规定。”
aimkey还在自己的Twitch直播间晒出了与Embark的完整沟通记录，证实自己遭到的是硬件级封禁——这意味着他的设备将彻底无法运行这款游戏。
《Arc Raiders》此前经历了数月的内容平淡期，近期上线的“冰封之径”大型更新为游戏重新带回了大量人气。更新推出前，Embark就宣布将全面升级反作弊机制，违规者将直接永久封禁，不再采用临时限制或逐级警告的宽松处理方式。
在《Arc Raiders》的Reddit社区，不少玩家都对这一处理结果拍手称快，好比终于抓到了长期破坏游戏环境的害群之马，很高兴看到新反作弊机制落地后能拿出果断的处理措施。还有玩家调侃道：“连ID都叫aimkey（自瞄键）……也太讽刺了。”

content.v: 苹果标志性音乐播放器iPod迎来诞生25周年，它是乔布斯改变音乐产业的经典作品。
2001年10月23日，时任苹果CEO乔布斯正式发布第一代iPod。
这款曾经风靡全球的产品，不仅改变了人们听音乐的方式，也成为苹果发展历程中的重要里程碑。
初代iPod主打“把1000首歌装进口袋”，配备5GB硬盘、单色液晶屏和机械滚轮，最长续航可达10小时，售价为399美元（约合2664元人民币）。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792808378_825155.png
当时，iPod需要搭配Mac电脑和iTunes使用，通过FireWire接口传输音乐并为设备充电。
苹果曾表示，用户不到10秒就能传输一张CD中的歌曲，导入1000首歌也只需不到10分钟。
尽管发布之初，部分用户认为iPod售价过高，而且只能搭配Mac使用，但随着产品不断迭代，这款播放器很快打开了市场。

items.title: 《光与影：33号远征队》销量870万 无惧XGP分流创收3.66亿
items.summary: 据分析师统计，《光与影：33号远征队》自去年发售以来总销量已达870万份，累计营收3.66亿美元。尽管游戏已加入PC Game Pass订阅库，但其大部分销量仍来自Steam平台。阿利纳分析公司发布的一份报告，梳理了近年

content.v: 据分析师统计，《光与影：33号远征队》自去年发售以来总销量已达870万份，累计营收3.66亿美元。尽管游戏已加入PC Game Pass订阅库，但其大部分销量仍来自Steam平台。
阿利纳分析公司发布的一份报告，梳理了近年几款年度游戏大奖得主——《艾尔登法环》《博德之门3》《宇宙机器人》以及《光与影：33号远征队》——在各平台的销售数据。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792808081_993102.jpg
作为史上最成功的游戏作品之一，《艾尔登法环》的表现自然一马当先，累计销量3640万份，营收20亿美元;《博德之门3》紧随其后，销量2320万份，营收12亿美元。《宇宙机器人》累计销量470万份，营收2.91亿美元，考虑到它是平台独占作品，且所属的平台跳跃品类受众偏小众，这一成绩并不让人意外。
再来看最新一届、也是拿奖最多的年度游戏《光与影：33号远征队》，它和《博德之门3》一样包揽了五大重磅年度游戏奖项，追平了行业纪录。尽管销量和营收规模远不及《艾尔登法环》与《博德之门3》，但这款独立作品仍凭借870万份的销量斩获了3.66亿美元营收。
不过和另外三款游戏不同，《光与影：33号远征队》在上周之前一直对Xbox Game Pass订阅用户免费开放。在此期间，Xbox主机与PC Game Pass渠道合计为游戏带来了430万名玩家。阿利纳将这种现象称为“Game Pass分流效应”——订阅服务确实分流了Xbox平台的销量，仅5.5%的游戏销量来自Xbox用户，但对PC端销量影响十分有限，Steam用户贡献了58.8%的销量。
尽管存在这种“分流效应”，《光与影：33号远征队》的创意总监纪尧姆·布罗什仍对Xbox Game Pass的价值持肯定态度。他表示，订阅制“降低了玩家的体验门槛”，尤其是 回合制 RPG本就容易“劝退偏好即时动作游戏的玩家”，订阅制恰好能抵消这一劣势。
与此同时，市场分析机构Circana的分析师马特·皮斯卡特拉也表示，这款游戏“是非常典型的案例，证明加入订阅服务反而有可能放大游戏的销售潜力”。
当订阅费成为体验游戏的唯一门槛，会有更多玩家愿意尝试本作，游戏口碑也会随之持续扩散。诚然，有430万名玩家没有购买就玩到了游戏，但这不代表如果没有订阅服务，这430万人都会直接全款购买这款游戏。

items.title: 外媒呼吁所有人承认《龙腾4》很棒 被冲3500楼遭狂骂
items.summary: 日前，外媒Polygon发布了一篇颇具争议的文章，标题直言：“我们能不能终于达成共识，承认《龙腾世纪4：影障守护者》其实是一款很棒…

content.v: 由你来说： Polygon发文呼吁大家承认《龙腾世纪4》其实很棒，结果评论区被玩家冲了3500楼，直接被骂成“带节奏博流量”。你觉得Polygon这波是真心平反，还是纯属标题党蹭热度？
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241005158921.png
日前，外媒Polygon发布了一篇颇具争议的文章，标题直言：“我们能不能终于达成共识，承认《龙腾世纪4：影障守护者》其实是一款很棒的游戏？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241006073150.jpg
文章发布后，社区反应相当激烈，大量玩家对这一观点表示不满，甚至直接将游戏称为“彻头彻尾的垃圾”，并批评Polygon是在故意制造话题、博取流量。这篇文章也被发布到了Polygon的官方X账号上。有用户为帖子添加了他们认为读者可能需要了解的背景信息，并将其标记为：“用户正在诱导互动，这违反了X的服务条款。”
在文章中，Polygon列举了多个理由，试图证明《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》值得重新评价：
首先，尽管游戏开发过程一度陷入混乱，还受到EA干预、网络负面舆论等因素影响，并且面临竞争激烈的2024年游戏市场，但最终成品依然相当出色。

其次，游戏的世界观与剧情对新玩家十分友好，采用了经典奇幻题材中常见的设定，即使没有接触过系列前作，也能轻松上手。战斗系统同样是Polygon认可的亮点。文章认为，本作的战斗操作流畅、体验爽快，玩家可以围绕三个带有冷却时间的技能搭配不同流派。相比系列前作，这套系统更加简单直接，战斗节奏也更快。在地图设计方面，《影障守护者》没有采用传统的大型开放世界，而是打造了多个规模紧凑、带有类银河城风格的区域。玩家会反复探索这些地方，并逐渐对它们产生熟悉感。Polygon认为，这种设计比充斥着空旷区域的庞大地图更有吸引力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241006239511.png
不过，Polygon认为游戏最出色的部分还是同伴角色。本作的七名同伴各具特色，拥有令人印象深刻的个人故事，并且会面临没有绝对正确答案的道德抉择。与此同时，主角也并非一个完全缺乏个性的空白角色。
然而，这些评价并没有说服大批玩家。评论区很快被嘲讽、表情包和讽刺图片占据，不少网友不仅批评游戏本身，也借机挖苦Polygon编辑部，认为这篇文章不过是典型的标题党内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241006341647.png
《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》于2024年末发售，推出后便在系列粉丝之间引发了明显分歧。一部分玩家认可游戏的战斗系统、视觉风格以及部分剧情，另一部分玩家则猛烈批评其角色塑造、对话、政治表达，以及作品整体给人带来的陌生感，认为它已经不再是自己熟悉的《龙腾世纪》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241006356287.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241006365180.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610241006361109.png
时隔近两年，Polygon再次将这款游戏推到讨论中心，试图呼吁玩家重新审视它的优点。不过，从目前的社区反应来看，这一呼吁并未得到广泛认同。
此次文章发布的背景也颇为微妙。EA此前宣布关闭BioWare，这篇评论将《影障守护者》描述为工作室的“绝唱”。然而，玩家显然没有多少怀旧情绪。BioWare关闭的消息传出后，便有不少玩家将工作室的衰落归咎于《影障守护者》的表现。

content.v: Reddit用户w4rlock999正在为PC版《巫师》初代制作战斗改造模组，尝试移植《巫师3：狂猎》的战斗动作与部分机制。该项目仍处于早期开发阶段，目前公开的制作中视频展示了初步战斗效果。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806866_296735_jpg_r.jpg
这一社区项目出现时，《巫师》重制版正因与《巫师4》存在技术依赖而暂时停止开发。现有模组版本仍较为粗糙，整体方案也尚未完善，不过演示中的战斗节奏已经显露出一定潜力。
2007年推出的《巫师》采用BioWare的Aurora引擎，原版战斗带有节奏游戏性质。玩家需要根据光标变化及时点击，时机错误会受到惩罚。游戏没有常规闪避手段，更强调战前准备，并设置三种战斗姿态应对不同敌人。
仅替换《巫师3：狂猎》的动作和机制，可能不足以彻底重构初代战斗。原有姿态、敌人设计和准备系统仍需配套调整，否则新旧机制之间难以形成完整衔接。
该模组尚未公布发布日期，最终功能、兼容版本及运行稳定性也未确定。它未来或许能降低玩家重温初代时面对旧战斗系统的门槛，但现阶段仍是一项尚不能下载的早期社区实验。

content.v: 技能树、战斗与视觉表现的整体重做，显著改变了《 巫师3：狂猎 》重制版的游玩感受。这些改动也让该作成为GamesRadar+一名作者心中的“年度游戏”，而非一次单纯的画面翻新。

content.v: 可以说，Steam最大的痛点在于平台每日上架的游戏数量过于庞大，玩家很难从中发掘出真正优质有趣的新作。去年，Valve推出了名为“个人日历”的测试功能，它立刻成为Steam上筛选新游的实用利器。如今，这项功能终于正式脱离测试阶段，全面上线。
Valve在公告中说明：“随着今日Steam更新推送，个人日历功能正式从Steam实验室毕业，成为Steam商店的一项完整正式功能。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806759_319662.jpg
个人日历页面的功能直白易懂。页面会以日历形式展示未来八周内，Valve算法判定你可能感兴趣的游戏。用户可以自行调整日历视图中显示的游戏数量，也能选择特定的品类与主题标签，进一步缩小筛选范围。
即便还在测试阶段，我就认为个人日历是查看Steam待发售游戏最简洁清晰的方式。我向来对算法推荐引擎持怀疑态度，但Valve这套底层筛选机制确实过滤掉了大量无关内容，还精准匹配了我的喜好。
Valve表示，推荐逻辑“基于你高频游玩的游戏”。“系统会重点参考你游玩时长最长的游戏数据。因此，试玩一两款新游戏几分钟，不会对推荐结果产生明显影响;但如果投入大量时间游玩一款新的心仪作品，就会显著改变推荐方向。”
开发团队承诺，日历中不存在任何赞助推广位，同时也尽可能避免用户陷入“过滤气泡”——也就是反复只被推荐同类型游戏。Valve解释道：“不可能每天都有和你常玩游戏同类型、同主题，同时又适合推荐给你的新游上架。”这一机制能让日历中呈现的游戏品类更加丰富多元。

content.v: 《上古卷轴5：天际》是有史以来最具影响力的角色扮演游戏之一。游戏发售至今已近15年，却仍在不断获得官方内容更新和玩家制作的模组。尽管我们已经得到了一些有关《 上古卷轴6 》发售日期的线索，但续作的许多要素，包括剧情细节以及它在《上古卷轴》时间线中的位置，对粉丝来说仍是谜团，而且这种神秘状态很可能还会持续一段时间。不过，在继续等待的同时，有一件事值得我们猜测：哪些《天际》角色可能会在这部备受期待的续作中回归。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792796847_979723_jpg_r.jpg

角色回归对《上古卷轴》系列而言并不新鲜。尽管目前还不知道《上古卷轴6》发生在哪个年代，但如果它延续前几部作品的趋势，那么可以合理推测，其故事至少发生在《天际》的整整一代人之后，甚至更加久远。即便如此，这个系列中仍有许多不死或寿命极其漫长的角色，他们曾在多部游戏中登场。因此，让一些深受粉丝喜爱的《天际》角色在《上古卷轴6》中回归非常合理，而其中有一位备受喜爱的角色，是我们无论如何都希望在续作中见到的。
帕图纳克斯
帕图纳克斯是一条远古巨龙，也是《天际》主线任务中最有趣的角色之一。这个仿佛不受时间影响的存在，自泰姆瑞尔第一纪元以来便一直活着。考虑到大多数玩家都拒绝按照戴尔芬的要求杀死它，那么到了《上古卷轴6》所处的时代，这条巨龙仍然活着才合乎情理。
作为灰胡子的领袖，帕图纳克斯既是一条巨龙，也是一位离群索居、如同僧侣般的存在。它选择反思自己过去对人类犯下的暴行，这使其成为《上古卷轴》系列中最聪明、最复杂的角色之一，也代表了该系列角色塑造的最高水准。尽管它曾是对抗奥杜因时不可或缺的助力，但这条睿智的巨龙或许仍有一些智慧，可以传授给系列的下一位主角。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806287_998819.webp
帕图纳克斯身处天际省的世界之喉，因此，设想它只需进行一次短途飞行，就能前往传闻中的《上古卷轴6》舞台——落锤省和高岩省，并不算牵强。
泰德林·塞罗
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806286_405435.webp
泰德林·塞罗是一名丹莫佣兵，玩家可以选择在鸦石镇雇用他。与这份名单上的其他一些人选相比，他的知名度较低，但仍然是最适合在《上古卷轴6》中回归的角色之一。
起初，他看起来不过是又一名普通的佣兵同伴，但那些在游戏中雇用过泰德林的玩家会发现，他是一位出人意料的强大盟友，而且有着相当丰富的人物塑造。作为一名丹莫，泰德林本就拥有极其漫长的寿命，因此即使没有任何不死能力或魔法手段，他也完全可以在《上古卷轴6》中客串登场。作为一名佣兵，不难想象他为什么会离开鸦石镇的家，前去探索世界其他地方，而且乘船前往高岩省的路程也算不上特别遥远。
泰德林的佣兵生涯可能会让他成为《上古卷轴6》主角的一位强力盟友，再次运用自己身为魔剑士的本领帮助玩家。
“骗子”迈克
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806286_348850.webp
与其说名单中的这位角色有可能回归，不如说他肯定会在下一部《上古卷轴》游戏中登场，而且之后的每一部《上古卷轴》作品里很可能也都会有他。随着《上古卷轴6》的开发按计划继续推进，我们几乎可以确信，“骗子”迈克已经确定会在游戏中登场——如果他现在还没有被加入游戏的话。
“骗子”迈克会在每一部《上古卷轴》游戏中登场，他存在的目的就是散播有关游戏剧情和背景设定的错误信息。尽管这名神秘虎人的来历无人知晓，但玩家猜测，他要么是一名不死的恶作剧者，要么来自一个成员寿命极其漫长、世代使用同一名字的虎人氏族。仅靠询问这个角色是不可能得到答案的，因为他，嗯……会撒谎，而且经常撒谎。
卡莉亚
卡莉亚是另一名丹莫，她漫长的寿命使其自然具备了在《上古卷轴6》中登场的条件。她是玩家在盗贼公会任务线中遇到的一名非玩家角色。她在这条任务线中的表现不仅非常有趣，还可能拥有《天际》所有非玩家角色中最引人入胜的背景故事之一。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806286_949411.webp
她是巴兰兹雅女王和德雷文·因多里尔的孙女，而传闻德雷文·因多里尔是因多里尔·尼瑞瓦的后裔。卡莉亚因此与晨风历史上两位最著名、最有趣的人物都有联系。此外，她与盗贼公会之间也有着一段漫长而传奇的历史：她曾是前公会会长兼夜莺加卢斯·德西德尼乌斯的恋人，后来也为他的死亡报了仇。
不难想象卡莉亚会以怎样的方式出现在《上古卷轴6》中：她最有可能负责引导玩家加入盗贼公会，甚至可能亲自担任公会会长。考虑到这个角色充满传奇色彩的过往，如果不能在《上古卷轴》中看到她更多的故事，无疑会是一件憾事。
瑟拉娜
瑟拉娜或许是整个《天际》中最受喜爱的非玩家角色。她是一名纯血吸血鬼，也是一名永久随从，并且拥有整款游戏中最悲惨、最引人入胜的背景故事之一。她尖刻而内敛的性格、精彩绝伦的故事线，以及作为随从的实用性，都令粉丝为之着迷。我们无论如何都希望看到她重返这个系列。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792806287_547906.webp
瑟拉娜在《天际》的首个DLC《黎明守卫》中登场。她是一名纯血吸血鬼，是“冷港之女”之一，也是哈孔领主的亲生女儿。在漫长的不死生命中，瑟拉娜大部分时间都处于封印之中，以免遭到父亲的伤害。她的父亲想把她作为仪式祭品的一部分，以此战胜太阳。在被龙裔释放、父亲带来的威胁也被永久消除之后，瑟拉娜终于可以自由漫游这个自己与之隔绝了如此之久的世界。
即使这份名单上的其他角色都无法在《上古卷轴6》中回归，瑟拉娜也应该回来。她给遇见过她的玩家留下了长久而深刻的印象，成为《上古卷轴》历史上最令人难忘、最受喜爱的非玩家角色之一。不仅如此，看到她自由漫游、探索世界，也会让人觉得这是她那段悲惨故事最完美的延续。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: iPhone Duo出大问题：多人到手屏幕爆线开裂！
items.summary: 苹果iPhone Duo被曝屏幕铰链处开裂，多名用户开箱即现故障，非人为损坏可换新机。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240944368448.png
10月24日，据快科技报道，苹果新机iPhone Duo的屏幕问题引发关注。海外论坛与小红书上多名用户反馈，设备到手后便出现屏幕爆线或开裂的情况，且故障位置高度集中——几乎都出现在铰链正上方，多表现为屏幕一侧浮现一条亮像素线。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240944455827.jpg
一名澳洲用户称，设备在手约6小时、开合不到20次，向朋友展示展开时先感到内铰链处异样，随后听到清晰的“咔嚓”声，屏幕随即沿铰链裂开，内外均无磕碰痕迹。他前往Apple Store后，苹果直接为其更换了故障机。国内也有用户反映，正常展开屏幕时听到异响，折叠处出现一道约3厘米黑色竖裂痕。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240944555805.jpg
综合目前反馈，问题可能出在iPhone Duo的铰链上，但涉及规模不算大，不排除是装配公差导致，而非设计缺陷，具体情况仍有待观察。报道指出，若售后检测确认非人为造成，苹果将为用户更换新机；若判定为磕碰所致，则需用户自费维修。
按照苹果官网公示，未购买AppleCare+时，内屏损坏的保外维修预估费用为7998元；已购买的用户，内屏及意外损坏服务费为628元。截至目前，苹果尚未就这一批次的屏幕问题作出公开说明。

items.title: 百大UP王老菊7年花千万做的游戏上线了！获特别好评
items.summary: 《再再启程》，在Steam开启抢先体验后，好评率已达到89%

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240914241796.png
B站百大UP主“怕上火暴王老菊”历时七年打造的首款游戏《再再启程》，在Steam开启抢先体验后，好评率已达到89%。这款融合了轻度肉鸽与增量养成的2D冒险游戏，首发优惠价54.40元，原价68元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240915186949.png
《再再启程》的核心玩法围绕一辆在异世界横冲直撞的载具展开。屏幕上方是车辆行驶与战斗的画面，下方则是一整套需要玩家手动操作的机械仪表盘，通过拖动拉杆、旋转轴轮来完成装填、发射等动作，营造出颇具沉浸感的“驾驶舱”体验。EA版本包含4个世界群系、超过30名角色、60种设备与100件遗物，局外成长系统允许玩家将素材带回大本营升级载具天赋。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240915201179.png

王老菊的做游戏之路并不平坦。2019年他宣布跨界做游戏，此后团队至少启动过三个项目：异星模拟经营、佣兵团视角的冒险RPG，以及横版载具组装游戏，前两个均因开发难度和资金压力终止。最终团队收拢第三个项目已完成的资产，在较短的窗口期内做出了框架更简单的《再再启程》。2023年他曾坦言已投入约600万元，后续外界估计总投入可能接近千万元。他在定档自述中也很坦诚：这不是什么高大上的产品，而是一款“框架相对简单、但可行”的游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240917242768.png
从目前89%的好评率来看，玩家对这份“简单但可行”的答卷整体是买账的。作为一位从内容创作者转型制作人的首部作品，《再再启程》承载的不仅是一款肉鸽小品，还有两个被放弃项目的遗产，以及王老菊七年里反复推倒重来的成本。对于一路看他视频过来的观众而言，这或许也是另一种意义上的“再再启程”。

items.title: iPhone Duo全靠磨砂膜掩盖折痕 撕掉后折痕全暴露！
items.summary: 近日，有博主对苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 进行了拆解与实测，发现其内屏所谓的“纳米纹理黑科技”，实际上是一层可以直接用手…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240913334987.jpg
近日，有博主对苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 进行了拆解与实测，发现其内屏所谓的“纳米纹理黑科技”，实际上是一层可以直接用手撕下的磨砂表层。移除这层表层后，屏幕虽然变得更加清晰通透，但原本不太明显的折痕也随之暴露，引发了关于苹果是否在“遮掩折痕”的争议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240913396389.png
据实测，这层磨砂表面通过特殊的微结构改变光线反射方式，将镜面反射转化为漫反射，从而减弱折痕区域与周围屏幕之间的反光差异，让折痕在视觉上不那么明显。撕除后，内屏会呈现更清晰的亮面效果，但中央的物理折痕也更加醒目。
测试还显示，手机内屏采用双层结构，上层为定制聚合物磨砂层，下层则为高清保护层或超薄柔性玻璃（UTG）层，两者可以分别拆卸。
不过，能够撕下并不意味着可以自行操作。苹果官方强烈不建议用户擅自移除这层表面材料。根据相关信息，单独更换纳米纹理表层的费用为398元；如果操作不当导致柔性内屏损坏或出现漏液，保外更换整个内屏的费用则高达7998元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/24/small_202610240913481226.png
因此，尽管移除磨砂层能够让屏幕看起来更加通透，但也可能让折痕问题更加明显。对于普通用户而言，自行撕膜所带来的风险，显然不值得轻易尝试。

items.title: 公测定档11月26日！《蓝色星原》真的要来了？
items.summary: 千言万语汇成一句话：黄鸡啊，慢慢来不急，但现在一定要快啊！

content.v: 《蓝色星原：旅谣》（下简称《蓝色星原》）无疑是当前最让人期待与关注的二游之一。
早在24年，游戏的首曝PV就引发了不少人的关注；此后游戏的热度依旧不减，在经过几轮测试之后，在不久前也正式达到了全球2500万预约的显著成绩。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/15427.jpg
更重要的是，官方同样没有让玩家等待太久：《蓝色星原》将于11月26日正式开启公测，并且还将针对三测玩家反馈的问题，做出进一步的优化与调整！
所以说了这么多，《蓝色星原》到底是一款怎样的游戏？在正式公测前，又有哪些值得玩家期待的地方呢？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/15763.jpg
在谈及三测优化以及游戏正式公测之前，我们不妨先来聊聊《蓝色星原》本身：在二游赛道日益拥挤甚至饱和的今天，《蓝色星原》有哪些独特的优势？
首先，从前几轮测试也不难看出，《蓝色星原》无论是在玩法还是在内容体量方面，其实都有着相当丰富的表现。从大世界探索、战斗，到捉宠收集、模拟经营，《蓝色星原》将这些统统与“二次元开放世界”进行了一次有机整合，主打的就是一个量大管饱、一应俱全。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/31275.jpg
而这样做的好处也十分明显：不管你是那种类型的玩家，都可以在游戏中找到自己的游玩偏好。
从实际体验上来讲，《蓝色星原》确实会像一个大型游乐场：比如你享受捉宠的乐趣，大世界中就足足有200多种（三测数据）形态各异、各有特色的“奇波”等着你亲自邂逅：
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/32002.jpg
厌倦了战斗爽，你说你想种田养老？没问题，直接组成生产小组，主打的就是一个随心所欲；而在探索过程中，你同样可以遇到不少小游戏与特色事件......多个环节相互串联互补，这也是不少玩家纷纷感慨“上头”的原因之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/46545.jpg
当然，连接这种多元开放世界体现的核心，其实还是《蓝色星原》中大家喜闻乐见的不同角色。
毕竟大家也都知道，作为一款二游，角色塑造其实也是作品卖点的重中之重。而毫不夸张地说，《蓝色星原》同样也是将这一优势彻底做到极致的作品之一。仅从前几轮测试来看，《蓝色星原》中有关美术资源的积累，无论是在数量还是在质量方面，均达到了行业前列的水准。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/46642.jpg
熟悉开发厂商蛮啾的玩家应该知道啊，黄鸡在这块向来是以专业著称的。除了相当精细的美术模型，各种特色演出简直以一种全覆盖的姿态往上“堆料”：比如星结奇波的额外动画演出、“专武”灵子的2D平面动态效果，自然也包括大家喜闻乐见、各有特色的美少女角色......
只能说在美术与角色这块，黄鸡就不可能让大家失望，大家懂得应该都懂~
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/48288.jpg
既然简单说完了优点，那我们也必须唠唠在11月26日正式公测之前，官方又将对游戏做出哪个方向的优化与改动？
先说结论：改了，并且全都改在之前的“痛点”之上。
早在三测结束后不久，项目组就专门针对玩家意见进行了集中梳理与确认：比如玩家所关心的战斗优化、装备与波奇养成，以及资源福利获取等诸多方面，都有了不小的调整与优化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/55052.jpg
首先是有关玩法养成方面的全面减负。这一点其实也很好理解：毕竟当玩法内容体量大了，对于不同玩家来说多少会产生一点疲惫感。而《蓝色星原》给出的方案，就是直接从“养成成本”与“正反馈”上双管齐下，降低玩家在游玩时的门槛与压力。
比如针对养成方面，玩家现在通关高等级关卡后，将保底掉落1件金色装备，且升级材料需求门槛进一步降低；捕捉奇波的回响获取概率大幅提升，新增自选选项与保底机制等等，都让玩家更容易养成极品属性：
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/57540.jpg
另外，家园经营的体验优化同样不少：除了“一键收获”等交互体验的改善外，玩家产出订单总体上得到增加，而消耗端的输出则进一步降低；与此同时，新手引导、任务流程优化，星结卡使用等诸多细节改动，也会让玩家各部分的流程体验更加平滑。
更直观来讲，这些改动除了能让玩家的开荒体验好上不少外，由于“卡进度”所带来的挫败感也将大大降低，效果也算是立竿见影了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/64753.jpg
而同样一针见血的，还有战斗体验的大幅进化。制作组将本次优化的重心，落在了战斗节奏、敌人机制、操作反馈这一整条体验链路的关键环节上。
首先是改善自动战斗体验、梳理敌人架势破坏与超限伤害等机制，在保留原有战斗策略的同时，也让更多轻度玩家的体验更加流畅完整更重要的是，大世界头目的狂暴无敌效果也将被移除，这下妈妈再也不用担心我技能打空了！
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/71773.jpg
而针对追求挑战的玩家，“日渡尘影”整体流程也将得到进一步调整：第七层队伍需求从三队直接调整为两队，大大降低玩家养成的压力，也让奖励获取更加合理。
此外，还有性能优化、UI交互、大世界探索与副本体验等等长长一串清单，我们在这也就不一一说明了。总之，《蓝色星原》也确实向最终完整体不断迈进了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261023_xy_707_1/85181.jpg
最后，则是大家最关心的福利与资源体验环节。
事实上，游戏之前所展示的商业化内容，就已经确定了“抽卡不歪”基本方向：常驻池首次50抽送个自选，之后每次限定角色池都是90抽保底，从根本上杜绝了“抽歪”的可能性。
在经过本次三测的反馈后，官方承诺现在对福利投放、资源获取进行进一步调整与打磨，帮助玩家获取更加稳定的反馈。虽然没有给出更多具体的细节，但说明制作组也确实正在努力尝试调整。
说了这么多，说按照黄鸡以往的风格，这一块大家也不用过分担心，一起期待游戏正式公测吧！
总的来说，《蓝色星原：旅谣》无疑会是一部值得期待的作品，从其本身的题材、受众、玩法风格等各个方面来看，它似乎从来不缺对玩家们的吸引力；其独特的优势与美术长板，在当今市场中也仍会是强竞争力的存在。
当然，在多轮测试后，最终的打磨阶段同样也是必不可少的。考虑到11月26日的最终定档公测，算算时间其实也差不多咯。
千言万语汇成一句话：黄鸡啊，慢慢来不急，但现在一定要快啊！

items.title: 迈克尔·迈尔斯去世几个月后，《黎明杀机》删除了《恰吉》的内容
items.summary: Dead by Daylight fans are beside themselves after Behaviour Interactive announced that all Chucky content woul

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/23/dead-by-daylight-chucky-1792799484984.png
Dead by Daylight fans are beside themselves after Behaviour Interactive announced that all Chucky content would no longer be available to purchase starting next month.

The developer behind the popular asymmetrical horror game confirmed plans to pull the Chucky Chapter from sale in posts shared across social media. The message followed rumors that the possessed killer doll would soon be removed from the game, with the official statement promising that those who have purchased related content will be able to use it even after it is removed from shelves starting November 24, 2026.

"We welcomed The Good Guy out of his box and into The Fog nearly three years ago, but it's now time for the Chucky Chapter to leave the shelf," Behaviour said . "On November 24, 2026, the Chapter and its associated content will be removed from in-game and first-party stores. Any content unlocked before that date will remain available to use in-game."

As detailed in an FAQ post shared by the developers, these changes to the Chucky Chapter mean a few things for Dead by Daylight players. Its Killer, known in-game as The Good Guy, will no longer be available to purchase, though bug fixes will still be supported. The collection of outfits and cosmetics he's gained since being added in 2023 will also be made unavailable, and no future add-ons for the character will be added.

In other words, if you're a Chucky fan who's been waiting to pull the trigger, you might want to start thinking about it. To help ease players into the idea of losing one of Dead by Daylight's most unique Killers, Behaviour is holding a sale for all items related to the Chucky Chapter starting Monday, October 26. The "Last Chance" sale runs until his November 24 removal date and slashes prices by 50% across all platforms.

Dead by Daylight and its collection of Killers has often been referred to as 'horror Super Smash Bros.' by fans, but Behaviour has plenty of experience when it comes to pulling Killers. Hellraiser's Pinhead was pulled from digital storefronts in 2025 after first joining in 2021. Halloween's Michael Myers, the first major playable Killer to join Dead by Daylight after its launch in 2016, was removed this past January.
@DeadbyDaylight I THOUGHT WE HAD A NICE LICENSE AGREEMENT!!!!! https://t.co/bOMgT44DQt

Although Behaviour refrained from sharing more details about why exactly the Child's Play rep is being removed, fans usually assume licensing issues are to blame. Hellraiser and Halloween both received new game announcements in Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival and Halloween: The Game that just happened to arrive around the time their respective properties were pulled from Dead by Daylight. Friday the 13th's infamous licensing kerfuffle is also allegedly what kept Jason Voorhees out of The Fog for years before he finally joined a few months back. Stranger Things is another example, with its first chapter's Demogorgon content removed before returning in 2023 .

Like Chucky, players who purchased pulled content can still use it freely even after it's removed from stores, but that doesn't mean other players can't feel the impact. Content being removed from purchase not only means that players won't be able to buy it in the future; it means that content will likely show up less frequently during matches.

That affects just about everyone who likes having their Survivor matches shaken up by new Killer abilities to keep them on their toes, as a player doesn't need to have purchased a chapter to play against its respective Killer. Considering Michael Myers left Dead by Daylight earlier this year and Pinhead was removed not much longer before that, players are feeling Chucky's pull from sale more than many of the previous Killer removals.
"Hold a license challenge: impossible," one fan said .
"How do you keep losing licenses bro?" another fan speculated . "I thought you had a good relationship. Chucky had many skins WTF :("
goodbye chuckster. i will always love you https://t.co/h6sUaDGrwI
Again, Behaviour has not explicitly stated why new players will not be able to purchase Chucky after that November cutoff date. IGN has reached out to the Dead by Daylight team for comment.

"This makes me so sad," one player on Reddit said . "Chucky is such a huge license and we've lost Michael and Pinhead already within the last two years. Not blaming BHVR for it, I get it's business. It just sucks."

"It's strange though. You'd assume they'd change their contractual agreements after losing Demogorgon the first time to prevent this from happening with recent Killers," another replied . "Michael/Pinhead are a bit understandable since those were older licenses, but I'd assume Chucky would've had a proactive contractual agreement to prevent this from happening?"

Although losing three Killers in the span of a year and a half might sting, Behaviour has continued to add new notable characters and franchises into the mix. After Tokyo Ghoul's Ken Kaneki and Five Nights at Freddy's Springtrap were added last year, the studio brought Stranger Things villain Vecna into The Fog. Jason joined in the summer of this year, and Terrifier's Art the Clown will be added next month. Although the majority of the game's licensed Killers have remained available for years and are still available to this day, how long they will remain available for purchase is unclear.

items.title: Steam 新品节特刊：2026 年 10 月（中）
items.summary: 我们从本期新品节挑选出来了一些作品，希望能够帮助大家直达游戏页面，淘得愉快！

content.v: https://hivebak.indienova.com/farm/article/headpic/2026/10/head-9258jh-banner-next-fest-2026-10-part-2.jpg

自 2019 年 12 月的首届 Steam 游戏节（The Game Festival，举办一届后更名）改名为 Steam 新品节（Steam Next Fest）以来，该线上节庆已逐渐定型为每年 2 月、6 月、10 月固定举办的新游戏展示会。在此期间，玩家可以体验游戏 Demo、观看来自开发者的实况直播，并将自己中意的游戏添加至愿望单。对于开发者而言，Steam 新品节是从玩家处获取早期反馈并为将来在 Steam 平台发行游戏积累受众群（以及愿望单数量）的大好机会。
最新一届 Steam 新品节 已于 10 月 20 日凌晨 01：00 开启，持续至 10 月 27 日。参加本届新品节的游戏数量爆炸式增长，indienova 内容团队从 7288 款参展新品中以带着客观意识羁绊的主观标准挑选出了 255 款潜力游戏，沿用《NOVA 海外独立游戏见闻》栏目“Demo 体验”部分的形式集结成刊，希望能够帮助大家直达游戏页面，淘得愉快！

content.v: Xbox首位首席运营官Helen Chiang已离开微软，距离她今年7月升任这一新设职位仅过去数月。Xbox首席执行官Asha Sharma已在内部通知中确认此事，并感谢Chiang多年来的工作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792796810_554940_jpg_r.jpg
Chiang在微软任职21年，曾负责《我的世界》。微软目前没有公开说明她在短暂任期后离开的原因。Xbox传播副总裁Kari Perez仅表示，公司不讨论个人的人事事项。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792796929_559148_jpg_r.jpg
Xbox设立首席运营官职位时，将其定位为重整计划的一部分。该职位负责内容、硬件、平台及服务的端到端损益管理，目标是将各项业务纳入统一运营模式，以改善投资决策、经验总结和业绩问责。
Chiang原有的直接职责现已分配给其他Xbox领导者。Sharma表示，相关方案确定后将公布首席运营官职能的后续领导安排，这意味着该职能目前并未明确取消，但继任方式仍未公开。

items.title: Barnes & Noble 发售首款 500 块地牢探索卡尔拼图
items.titleEn: Barnes & Noble Has the First 500-Piece Dungeon Crawler Carl Jigsaw Puzzle for Sale

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/23/dungeon-crawler-carl-puzzle-1792793594591.png
《地下城爬行者卡尔》系列今年在很多方面都取得了巨大的成功，但商品的快速扩张确实给该系列留下了深刻的印象。已经有 T 恤、图画小说、动作玩偶、桌面游戏，甚至万圣节服装可供购买，但现在您可以将拼图游戏添加到该列表中。
昨天在 Reddit 上发现，Barnes & Noble Stores 现已推出一款新的 500 块 DCC 拼图。它被称为“遇见爬行者”，并以书中所有熟悉的角色为特色，包括卡尔和甜甜圈。
令人惊讶的是，这甚至不是第一个官方的地下城爬行者卡尔拼图游戏。大约八个月前，在 Barnes & Noble 发现了一件来自同一品牌 Kingdom of Threads 的 250 件作品。因此，如果您一直想将您对解谜的热爱与对地下城探索者卡尔的热爱结合起来，那么您现在显然有选择。
随着 Renegade 工作室即将推出的桌面改编作品大受欢迎，马特·迪尼曼 (Matt Dinniman) 的 LitRPG 故事获得解谜处理也就不足为奇了。 Kingdom of Threads 可能不是最受欢迎的益智品牌之一，但他们已经与 AOTAR 和 Fourth Wing 等其他主要书迷合作了一段时间。

items.title: 为什么像刚刚收购 BioWare 那样的私募股权收购如此令人畏惧
items.summary: BioWare is just the latest casualty in a long history of private equity carnage.

content.v: The closure of BioWare has not come as a huge surprise. The LGBTQ-inclusive developer of Mass Effect and Dragon Age, which hadn't managed to transmute development mayhem into sales success and whose games aren't ideal environments for loot boxes, did not seem likely to be admired by its new owners, Saudi Arabia and Trump son-in-law Jared Kushner. Employees at the legendary RPG studio started working on their resumes as soon as the acquisition was announced.
But even if BioWare's new owners had been miscellaneous investors rather than Saudi royalty, the outlook would not have been good: This is what private equity does.

Public companies are of course plenty capable of blowing things up all on their own. EA's pre-acquisition attempt to turn BioWare into a live-service shooter studio was one of the great missteps of the live service goldrush, and Microsoft's pursuit of shareholder value has led to thousands of layoffs and numerous game cancellations.

But there is a particular, systematic way that leveraged private equity acquisitions consume companies rather than nurturing them. In the wake of BioWare's closure and 400 layoffs across EA, we have updated our previously-reported overview of the process that has led to the demise of a number of game studios and other companies.
How private equity acquisitions work

Ostensibly, the goal of a private equity acquisition is to optimize the bought-out company's performance for long-term returns, tapping underutilized potential—like EA's mobile business—to increase profits. But private equity firms have gained a sinister reputation thanks to a counter-intuitive strategy by which firms cannibalize their own acquisitions to extract maximum profits at the expense of the acquired company and its workforce.
That grisly process begins with the leveraged buyout, the most common form of private equity acquisition.

"A leveraged buyout just means the company is bought using a combination of borrowed money, or debt, and private equity," Kiplinger senior investing editor Karee Venema told PC Gamer last year. "The purchased company's balance sheet is used as collateral against the loans taken out to purchase it."
The private equity firm might have agreed to the terms of the loan, but repaying it becomes the purchased company's responsibility.

In other words, the "leverage" in the leveraged buyout is debt. Crucially, the collateral for that debt is the assets of the acquired company, not of the private equity firm itself. The investors are able to limit how much capital they have to supply for the buyout, while limiting their financial risk if repaying the loan—in EA's case, a $20 billion loan from JP Morgan—proves insurmountable. The private equity firm might have agreed to the terms of the loan, but repaying it becomes the purchased company's responsibility.

Reading that might produce a faint, dissonant tingle in the back of your mind. You might be wondering, "If private equity firms can take out loans that only their companies are responsible for, could they bleed more money out of a valuable company than they paid and avoid any consequences when that company goes bankrupt?"
And you'd be right to wonder, because that's exactly what private equity firms have become infamous for doing.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Crt9MrXnRKTkx7PBjmUocT-1920-80.jpg

If you're not terribly concerned about a company's long-term survival, there are myriad ways to drain it of as much value as possible. As the Guardian wrote in 2024, private equity firms have made a habit of hollowing out company workforces and raising prices to pull in unsustainable profit margins, aiming to cut loose before the resulting decline in product quality tanks sales and consumer sentiment. Others have liquidated company assets, selling off real estate, subsidiaries, and intellectual property to enrich the firms' investors.
Despite their role in precipitating bankruptcies, private equity firms often emerge financially unscathed.
Private Equity Stakeholder Project

Sometimes, those sold assets will end up driving the company further into debt through "sale-leaseback agreements," where the firm will arrange for the company to sell its real estate properties, pocketing the profits while the company is forced to pay rent to continue using its own business space. Meanwhile, the firm is likely extracting additional "management fees" : standard 2-and-20 terms see firms taking an annual 2% of a managed company's assets and 20% carried interest on all profits above a certain margin, while the company might face additional monitoring fees, transaction fees, and more.

Private equity has maimed retail franchises like Party City . It has brutalized digital media outlets like the Gizmodo Media Group and demolished local news across the US. It's left hospitals full of bats and increased mortality in retirement homes . A report using S&P data found that in 2024, private equity-backed companies accounted for more than 10% of all corporate bankruptcies and over 50% of bankruptcies with over $500 million in liabilities—but "despite their role in precipitating bankruptcies, private equity firms often emerge financially unscathed."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/e5m32waVVjCqE58sRktPAZ-1920-80.jpg
"There have certainly been instances of this—the 2017 bankruptcy of Toys 'R' Us is top of mind for me," Venema said. "But there have been successful private equity buyouts, too."

Hilton, for example, was arguably better off in 2018 when Blackstone sold its remaining stake from its 2007 LBO—sometimes called "the best LBO ever" in financial circles. And Dell, Venema said, went from a $25 billion buyout in 2013 to being valued today at nearly $100 billion after going public again in 2018.

But in the games industry, we've seen other cases where private equity has caused carnage. Just this week, in addition to BioWare's closure and hundreds of layoffs at EA, Scum developer Gamepires announced that it's laying off employees after being acquired eight months ago by the Emona Capital-backed Splash Damage Group. Just a few weeks before acquiring Gamepires, Splash Damage had performed its own layoffs in November 2025, only two months after it had been purchased in its own private equity acquisition .
EA's uncertain future

EA's fate may not be as dramatic as that of Toys 'R' Us. Saudi Arabia has invested heavily in gaming in recent years, and EA's sports games and shooters are opportunities for profit and global influence, even as triple-A gaming struggles with enormous budgets and increased competition for attention.

What we know for now is that, after laying off around 400 people, EA is continuing development of Marvel's Iron Man and the next Star Wars Jedi entry, as well as a Sims game codenamed "Project Evergreen"—though after BioWare's shuttering, Sims players are understandably concerned about what ideological pressures EA's new owners will exert on its developers.

EA Sports is of course not going anywhere, and Battlefield 6 and Apex will get continued support. And EA has confirmed that Respawn and DICE are collaborating on a new project, rumored to be the next Star Wars Battlefront.

items.title: 新泄露称，《质量效应 5》以“银河冷战”为背景，所有 3 个结局都包含在 1 个结局中
items.summary: The more I hear about what BioWare had cooking, the more pissed off I am that we're never going to get it.

content.v: Electronic Arts shuttered BioWare earlier this week, and that sucked. A concept trailer for the Mass Effect game the studio had in development subsequently leaked , and that made everyone feel even worse because—keeping in mind that it was an early-development concept piece—it looked really good.

YouTuber Dantics has now revealed more about what BioWare was actually working on, which he claims to be aware of because he was part of the Mass Effect community council, meaning he "saw what BioWare was building, and provided feedback during development."

We haven't directly confirmed Dantics' role on the council, although others on social media have vouched for him, and BioWare community councils are definitely a real thing: The studio has referenced them in past updates , and they can also be seen in credits for games including Mass Effect: Legendary Edition and Dragon Age: The Veilguard . Members of the ME5 council aren't known, but Mass Effect veteran Michael Gamble, the project lead on the next game, follows Dantics on X.

So, suitably caveated: Dantics said in a post on X that the next Mass Effect game was set 600 years after the Reaper War, and would put players in the role of a customizable N7 agent who would be "a cross between John Wick and James Bond." The galaxy in this future timeline was divided into three major factions: Humans, Batarians, Krogan, and others in one alliance, the "Council Races"—Asari, Salarians, and Turians—forming the second bloc, and the Geth emerging as the galaxy's third superpower. Instead of an existential crisis like the Reaper invasion, the new game would take place amidst a "galactic Cold War."

I can finally talk about Mass Effect Universe.Since Bioware closed I can now reveal that I was part of the Mass Effect Council, saw what BioWare was building, and provided feedback during development.• Set 600+ years after the Reaper War• You play as a customizable N7 agent• Instead of being a walking gun rack, you're a cross between John Wick and James Bond • Shepard's legacy preserved, regardless of your ending• A galaxy divided into three major factions• Humanity, Krogan, Batarians, and more allied together• Council races forming their own alliance• The Geth emerging as a third superpower• A galactic Cold War instead of another Reaper style invasion with a shadowy adversary• Geth-built megastructures• Connections between the Milky Way and Andromeda• Experimental technology implanted in you as a unique point of difference• Hacking and manipulating the environment• See through walls, identify systems, remotely trigger hazards and more• Handcrafted missions like ME1-3• But with Hitman-style freedom in how you complete them• Brutal close-range executions• Squadmates who can clash with each other• Romance wasn't being sanitised• Liara returns - now an incredibly powerful Asari MatriarchFrom what I saw, BioWare was making Mass Effect for us, the fans, not for people who don't exist. It looked incredible.And now we may never get to play it.Find out more here: https://t.co/kdWhbLdU0T#SaveMassEffect October 23, 2026

Dantics also said there would be connections between the Milky Way and Andromeda galaxies, that there would be "brutal close-range executions"—certainly something I want from my heroic space opera RPGs—that "romance wasn't being sanitized," which in the wake of Baldur's Gate 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 I assume means the full monty, and that Liara would return as a powerful Asari matriarch.

In a separate video, Dantics said the new game was being designed to accommodate all three Mass Effect endings, rather than committing to one of them as canon: 600 years into the future, the Reapers are "outdated tech," and thus not nearly the danger they were back in Shepard's day, and advances in cybernetics, which would be in common use, fit the synthesis ending. And if your Shepard opted to just blow everything up and survived the war, well, he didn't survive the passage of 600 years, although his "legacy" would have lived on.

I'm always a little iffy on fictional settings that extend themselves centuries into the past or future, and yet don't seem to meaningfully change: It bugged me in KOTOR, and it bugs me here. 600 years is a long time, but everyone's still walking around wearing the same clothes, shooting the same guns, and flying the same ships. Six centuries of technological evolution, and what did we get? The Normandy with aftermarket ground effects.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FJPZpPhvcXqQqquLRVnbDn-1920-80.jpg
(Forgive the resolution, the trailer is only 720p.)

Anyway, with that off my chest, Dantics' rundown of BioWare's plan for the game sounds pretty great: Similar enough to the Shepard trilogy to bring back fans put off by the poisoned well of Mass Effect: Andromeda, yet distant enough to enable BioWare to do new things. Not all that terribly new, obviously: There's big trouble in the shadowy corners of the cosmos and we're sending our best super-shooter to clean it up (with a little help from his friends) , well, that's just Mass Effect. But Mass Effect is what we want, and sometimes you just have to admit that 'more' is good enough.

Alas, it's almost certain there will be no more. Unless EA is willing to offload the Mass Effect property to someone (the government of Canada , perhaps?)—and at this point it's shown no interest in doing so—then this is as close as we'll ever get to it.

content.v: 近日一份新报告披露，尽管Xbox高管的薪酬与业绩指标直接挂钩，但过去六年中，他们有五年都没能完成既定的绩效考核目标。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792792552_603904_jpg_r.jpg
这份关于Xbox高管未达标情况的信息来自GameFile的报道。微软原本设定目标：截至2026年6月30日，Xbox内容与服务营收要实现4.3%的增长。但实际结果非但没有增长，反而同比下滑了6%。
报道显示，Xbox业绩考核指标，和微软整体业务目标并不完全相同。自2020年开始，包括部门CEO在内的Xbox高层，薪酬奖金就和这套业绩目标进行绑定。考核早期阶段，业绩指标主要围绕XGP订阅用户数量增长。2023年后，考核重点变更为Xbox内容与服务营收增长。但过去六年时间里，高管有五次未能达成这项考核指标。
新任CEO上任之后，Xbox一直在积极推动提升内容与服务板块收入。玩家已经可以看到诸多动作：Game Pass推出全新云游戏档位、平台重新发力独占游戏、更新品牌形象，新增XP体系、Xbox实验室项目等等。不过这位新任 CEO并不期待立刻见到回报，而是选择以长期视角看待业务发展。

items.title: 根据玩家数据，Capcom 对《鬼武者：剑道》的难度水平非常满意：“我们认为它击中了正确的位置”
items.summary: Too easy, too hard, or just right?

content.v: One of the big topics of conversation around Onimusha: Way of the Sword when it released last month—and even before that, when Capcom first put out a demo of the game—was whether it was too easy. Viral clips of early game enemies standing around doing nothing gave the impression of a woefully easy game for action fans coming from the likes of Sekiro, Nioh or Ninja Gaiden. Once I played the full game, I found those fears mostly unfounded , but it's true that Onimusha's basic enemies pose little threat compared to its bosses, and mostly serve as fodder for you to cut through as you explore.

Way of the Sword's harder difficulty option being locked behind beating the campaign didn't necessarily endear the game to hardcore action players, either, so I'm not shocked that one of the most popular downloads on the game's Nexusmods page is one that amps up enemy aggression .

But I still mostly loved Onimusha , and didn't find myself craving the brutal difficulty of Sekiro or Nioh while I was playing it. With more than a month of hindsight to see how players have studied the blade, Capcom also seems pretty happy with the level of challenge it settled on.

"We've been looking at the data that comes back from people playing, so we can see where people are struggling and how they're progressing through the game. What we've seen in the trends in the data is that it's close to what we set out to achieve, in terms of difficulty," director Satoru Nihei said in an interview with PC Gamer.
Nihei elaborated that Capcom has observed players being able to progress through the story, but not entirely without friction.

"There are points where they do stumble, they do die, they do get defeated. But they're able to overcome that and progress. That was what we set out to achieve in terms of pitching the difficulty for the game: We wanted players to be able to progress through the story, but also have some challenge to it, so they get a sense of satisfaction from defeating enemies. It was never an intention for this game to be a particularly difficult game, like those other games you mentioned. We think it's hit the right spot in terms of the difficulty, in terms of where we wanted to place it."

My biggest criticism of Way of the Sword was its length, rather than its level of challenge. Its swordplay feels so good that I don't mind being able to run into a group of hapless enemies milling around the hub world of Kyoto and cut them down in a few seconds, but I did tire of Kyoto's generic sidequests, samey streets and how many times the game ultimately trotted out repeats of some of its boss fights.
Nihei said that Capcom has noted that feedback from other players, too. Ultimately the size of the game came from the priorities the dev team set out to meet early in development.

"We really wanted to have a game that was around the 20 hour mark. We didn't want to have a title that would be too small, but also looking at open world games that are 40 hours-plus, we didn't want to drag it out to that extent. So from the beginning there was this clear goal of … a mostly linear experience, and then we have the exploration elements for people who want to engage with them. That was what we set out to shoot for in terms of giving players enough volume to enjoy."
As for how many times you fight bosses like Byakue and Dohatsu-ten?

"We understand that some people might find fighting the same bosses to be a little draining, and it would've obviously been nice for us to be able to make a greater variety of bosses," Nihei said. "But also, at Capcom we want to make these very engaging, fun encounters that people can enjoy fighting again and again and again, so that was what we were aiming for when we created those bosses. But we've definitely heard the feedback."

content.v: 近日EA关闭生软，取消开发《 质量效应 5》。一些粉丝请求《幻兽帕鲁》开发商Pocketpair从EA手中购买《质量效应》IP。Pocketpair高管表示，公司仅在过去一天便收到接近30条相关私信或邮件，但IP交易远比粉丝设想复杂。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792791808_185564_jpg_r.jpg
Pocketpair传播与发行负责人John“Bucky”Buckley表示，每当一款游戏被取消或一家工作室关闭，公司都会收到大量要求其买下相关IP的评论和邮件。几个月后，部分声音还会变成“为什么没有购买，你们明明有钱”。谈到此次收到的《质量效应》相关请求时，他还开玩笑称，《翡翠帝国》或许更能引起自己的兴趣。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792793325_799205.png
Buckley解释称，IP持有者往往根本无意出售；即使愿意谈判，开价也可能相较IP的潜在价值高得不合理。确实有公司会尝试购买或授权游戏IP，以延续已经取消或停止运营的作品，但权利方不愿合作时，外部公司能做的事情十分有限。
目前没有证据表明EA愿意出售《质量效应》IP，也无法判断潜在交易价格是否合理。《幻兽帕鲁》及其衍生项目与质量效应擅长的大型角色扮演游戏也存在明显差异。现阶段，此事仍是粉丝提出的愿望及Pocketpair高管对交易障碍的回应，并不代表该公司已经提出收购。

content.v: 《全面战争：幕府将军2完全版》推出后因成品质量引发玩家强烈不满，世嘉在发售仅数日后将其撤下销售。Creative Assembly随后确认，本作由外部团队开发，目前正在评估后续处理方式。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261024/1792789552_967423_jpg_r.jpg
Creative Assembly负责《全面战争》的副总裁罗杰·科勒姆表示，这款游戏并非由Creative Assembly亲自开发，也没有经过工作室惯用的内部评审和质量保证流程。当时各团队正集中投入后续大型项目，工作室未能充分监督外部开发。不过，他承认《全面战争》是Creative Assembly的品牌，团队必须对未达到标准的结果负责并设法修复。
对于本作疑似使用生成式AI的争议，科勒姆称Creative Assembly会将AI工具用于分析、调试和快速原型制作，但不会使用生成式AI制作游戏内素材，并要求外部合作团队遵循相同标准。团队现正调查《全面战争：幕府将军2完全版》的具体情况。相关声明没有点名外包方，Steam页面则将华沙工作室Mataboo列为项目的第二家工作室。
部分玩家认为Creative Assembly仍应对最终发行版本承担责任，并质疑其员工曾在发行前直播宣传，却没有发现明显问题。目前，一支由Creative Assembly资深开发人员组成的小团队正与世嘉及未具名的外部工作室共同评估后续处理方式。

据Dantics的说法，玩家将操控一名可完全自定义的N7特工，人物风格被形容为“约翰・威克与詹姆斯・邦德的结合体”。故事发生在收割者战争结束600多年之后。无论玩家在原版三部曲选择哪一种结局，薛帕德的精神遗产都会在这个时代留存下来。故事核心是一场银河冷战，整个银河系分裂成三大对立势力。串联整个故事的关键人物是莉亚拉・T・索尼，也就是薛帕德的老战友、可发展恋爱关系的阿萨瑞族角色。数百年过去，她已成长为实力极其强大的阿萨瑞女族长。

人类、克洛根、巴塔瑞等多个种族组建为一个同盟势力。

盖斯合成人，崛起成为银河系第三大超级强权。

剧情 会建立起银河系与仙女座星系之间的剧情联系。

可以入侵设备、操纵周边环境。

items.title: Arkane 的时间可能不多了
items.summary: The famed immersive sim studio just got an extra month to find a new buyer, but will likely close if there are

content.v: Arkane Lyon may soon be facing closure, according to a new report by French site Le Monde , which says a deadline to find a buyer for the studio will land on November 13, at which point Microsoft could close the studio outright. Microsoft has since extended that deadline by a month, however, so it can continue to pursue alternative options.

Arkane Lyon was caught up in this year's vortex of Xbox layoffs, announced in July , which will see roughly 3,200 people put out of work. Xbox also dumped four studios: Double Fine , Compulsion Games , and Undead Labs all went independent (and almost immediately laid off large numbers of employees) while Hellblade developer Ninja Theory appears to be closing outright. Because Arkane is based in France, Xbox couldn't just drop the hammer on it. Instead, it began a legally-required consultation process "to review potential strategic options."

The Le Monde report says that on July 16, 10 days after the Xbox layoffs were announced, Arkane management informed employees that Xbox intended to close the studio. France's " Florange Law ," however, requires companies with more than 1,000 employees who want to close a facility to undertake a search for a buyer first.

The deadline for that requirement in Arkane's case is November 13, after which Xbox will presumably be free to close the studio. That option is definitely on the table: The Le Monde report says documents signed in July and published on a French government website on August 10 specifically reference "the plan for the complete and permanent cessation of the company's activities" and "the subsequent plan for the dismissal of all employees for economic reasons."

The report also says the Printemps Écologique and the Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Vidéo (STJV) unions were seeking to have the November consultation deadline extended to allow for redundancy negotiations and the buyer search to continue, and that has now happened.

"We have extended the consultation period by one additional month as we explore options, including finding a partner to support the studio through the development work still ahead," a Microsoft representative told PC Gamer, referring to the Marvel's Blade game currently in development at Arkane. "This is a defined extension, and we remain committed to keeping the Works Council informed throughout the process."

Regarding the documents referencing the planned closure of Arkane should a buyer not be found, the rep said that they "are part of the required consultation process and do not represent a final decision."

The Le Monde report says 217 people are employed by Arkane. Sources close to the studio say that despite being announced three years ago, at the 2023 Game Awards, Marvel's Blade still has years to go before development will be complete.

items.title: 这是我们新的日常游戏迷恋，我们都对此感到厌烦：你能猜出二手车值多少钱吗？
items.summary: Like Wordle, but it's about pricing used cars.

content.v: I'm always on the lookout for a new daily game I can play on my phone because, quite honestly, I'll do just about anything to delay getting out of bed for just a few more minutes in the morning. If you're into games like Wordle but are looking for an interesting new twist, here's a pitch:
Wordle, but it's about pricing used cars

Congratulations on your new job at The Daily Lowball , a used car lot where you have to prove to your boss that you know how much second-hand vehicles are worth. Each day in the puzzle, you're served up five real cars complete with photos and stats: the make and model, what year it's from, how many miles it's got on it, and how much it sold for when it was new.

Then you enter a guess how much you think each used car was sold for on the date shown. You're graded from A-F on your guesses by your virtual boss, and if you want to keep your daily streak intact, you'd better be accurate. Perform poorly enough on any given day, or string a few bad days together, and you're fired—you'll have to start your streak over.

It's an easy game to grasp but boy, we here at PC Gamer sure stink at it. My first day on the lot wasn't so smooth after I completely misjudged the resale price of a 2014 Audi Allroad Quattro and utterly biffed my guess on a cherry red 2005 Dodge Neon SRT-4. I did a little better on the 2008 Mercury Grand Marquis and the 2001 Porsche Boxter, and actually nailed the 2001 GMC Yukon. That gave me a C average for the day, so at least my streak has begun.

The other members of PC Gamer I sent the puzzle to didn't fare that well, either. I won't name and shame but there were two Ds and one F among my coworkers. If I'm the lone car guy at PCG, we're all in trouble.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WmdYXH7wvTDyuzv5BiSFbh-1920-80.jpg

Turns out it's fun to peer at used cars and try to figure out what they're worth, or at least what some real-world person thought they were worth when they bought them. And questions abound while I played a few more past puzzles, like "How does someone only have 8,000 miles on their 1985 Mazda RX-7? What, do they live in a walkable city or something? Insanity."

The site has a few other daily car-based games, like "Steal or Bad Deal" where you judge whether someone paid an acceptable amount for a used car or got ripped off, "Higher or Lower" where you're presented with two cars and have to guess which is more expensive, and a licence plate slot machine game where you try to roll a rare plate every day. Check out The Daily Lowball for yourself, and feel free to share your results in the comments.

content.v: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 released today, October 23, and the game's first DLC pack is available now. In keeping with Call of Duty tradition, the day-one DLC is a Call of Duty Endowment (CODE) pack , with proceeds going to Activision's charity that supports military veterans find new jobs after they leave the service.
The CODE Valor Pack adds the real-life Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter to the game as a playable character.

Carpenter was in Marjah, Afghanistan, when, on November 21, 2010, he put himself in front of a grenade to help save the life of his fellow Marine, Nick Eufrazio. Carpenter sustained serious injuries from the grenade blast. He was unconscious for five weeks, had his teeth stripped from his mouth, and lost an eye. He sustained numerous other life-threatening injuries in the blast.

Carpenter received the Medal of Honor from President Barack Obama in 2014. At the ceremony, Obama said, "They found Kyle lying face down, directly over the blast area. His helmet was riddled with holes. His gear was melted. Part of his Kevlar vest was blown away. One of the doctors who treated him later said Kyle was, 'Literally wounded from the top of his head to his feet.'"

Carpenter underwent brain surgery to remove shrapnel from his head. He had about 40 other surgeries to addresses his injuries, which included a collapsed lung, fractured fingers, and one arm that broke in more than 30 places. He had multiple skin grafts and now has a prosthetic eye, a new jaw, and new teeth.

The Valor Pack includes the Relentless and Valor skins, along with new weapon blueprints, a combat knife, and a weapon charm, among other things. All proceeds from the $20 DLC bundles will go to the CODE charity.

items.title: Creative Assembly 高管将《幕府将军 2》重制版的混乱归咎于其他人：“这不是 Creative Assembly 开发的游戏”
items.summary: Roger Collum says Creative Assembly was "focused on our next big projects," and didn't pay enough attention to

content.v: Excitement over the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster turned to a very different emotion when it launched and turned out to be quite bad —so bad that Sega pulled it from sale just a couple days later. Now, Roger Collum, vice president of Total War at developer Creative Assembly, has posted an update on the situation in the Total War subreddit (via RPS ), saying that the studio, like the fans, are "angry and disappointed" about the state of the game—which he says is not really CA's fault.

"This was not a Creative Assembly developed game," Collum wrote. "It wasn’t subject to our same internal reviews and quality assurance. We took our eyes off its external development, with all our teams focused on our next big projects. However, whatever the development arrangements, Total War is our franchise and our name is on it.
"The studio is full of craft people who care deeply about the experiences we give to our players. Shogun 2—CE did not meet that bar. We have to own that and we have to fix it."

Collum also addressed complaints about the apparent use of generative AI in the remaster, saying that Creative Assembly is a "craft studio," and that while it uses AI tools for tasks like "analysis, debugging, or speedy prototyping," it does not use generative AI to create in-game assets. "We demand the same of any external developers we work with," he wrote. "The situation with Shogun 2: Complete Edition is being investigated."

Collum didn't name the external developer of the Shogun 2 remaster, but the Steam page lists Warsaw-based Mataboo as the second studio on the project. Mataboo's website says it provides "complete end-to-end game development support," with services ranging from design and tool development to porting, optimization, compliance Q&A, and maintenance, on both PC and consoles. The studio has previously worked on games including The Blood of Dawnwalker, Silent Hill 2, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League, The Lord of the Rings: Gollum, The Medium, and numerous others.

Collum's statement doesn't appear to be going down perfectly smoothly among Total War fans. Many responses say that Creative Assembly is ultimately responsible for the game that goes out the door, and that the issues in the Shogun 2 remaster aren't small, intermittent, or otherwise easy to miss. Others point out that Creative Assembly's promotional efforts included a pre-launch livestream in which employees enthused about the game, apparently without having played it to any meaningful extent.

Collum concluded by asking fans not to direct their anger at individual developers. "As a team, we want to be transparent with our communications as much as possible, but that cannot be at the expense of the safety of our people," he wrote. "Please help keep Total War’s community spaces constructive and safe for everyone.

"I’ve said it before: when the team does well, it’s all about them. When we get it wrong, it’s on me. You absolutely have the right to be mad, and to criticise us, but direct it at me. We know we must earn your trust by making good games, and crucially, by how we respond when we get things wrong. We’re human, we will get things wrong, and I promise as long as I’m here, when that happens, we’ll hold our hands up and try to make it right."
"A small team of senior developers" from Creative Assembly are now working with Sega and the unnamed external studio to figure out where to go from here.

items.title: “每一周都会感觉天塌下来了”：Cloudflare 首席执行官表示，要应对“几年”人工智能驱动的互联网安全混乱
items.summary: This week's PHP crisis is likely just the first of many.

content.v: If you spent much time online this week, you likely noticed how it briefly felt like the end of days as government websites, game marketplaces , and furry image boards alike were pulled offline in a scramble to address newly-discovered security vulnerabilities in PHP—a scripting language used by roughly 70% of the world's websites, according to some estimates .

It was a harrowing incident, revealing flaws in foundational internet infrastructure that might have turned some of the most popular web destinations into attack vectors. And in an interview with Reuters, Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince says we should expect to see similar episodes on a regular basis in the years ahead as LLM technologies accelerate the discovery of exploitable security vulnerabilities.

Prince said that Cloudflare—a major cloud networking and cybersecurity provider that a massive number of websites relies on—is aware of "a bunch of additional severe vulnerabilities that are present in other pieces of critical software" like those that triggered the PHP panic earlier this week. And as both cybersecurity experts and bad actors task LLMs with identifying previously unrecognized weaknesses in the core technologies of the internet, there will likely be more to follow.
"I think we're going to have a couple years where every single week it's going to feel like the sky is falling," Prince said.

Previously, the rate at which exploitable flaws in software could be identified was limited by the finite number of experts able and willing to devote the necessary time and attention. Likewise for those seeking to weaponize those flaws.

For a user directing a workforce of LLM agents, however, those limitations are less relevant. Wiz Research, one of the firms that identified the recent PHP exploits with the assistance of LLM tools, wrote in a blog detailing its findings that "the economics of both discovery and exploitation" have changed.

"Frontier models were critical to making this process practical, enabling us to develop and adapt working exploits across multiple applications in hours," Wiz Research said. "As the time and expertise required for this work decrease, complexity may no longer provide a meaningful barrier, changing how we define what is vulnerable in practice."

But while Prince expects busy months ahead for those whose job it is to address the rising tide of LLM-empowered exploits, he said it will—in the long term—lead to more secure software as those newly-identified vulnerabilities are patched.
"The reality is, we're going to get a lot of this stuff cleaned up," he said.
In the short term, however, my advice is to stay on top of your browser and app updates. In the years ahead, some extra paranoia won't hurt.

items.summary: Award-winning voice actor Jennifer Hale, best known for voicing the female version of Commander Shepard in the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/22/me-1792674182792.jpg

Award-winning voice actor Jennifer Hale, best known for voicing the female version of Commander Shepard in the first three Mass Effect games, is speaking out after a leaked trailer for the sci-fi franchise’s next title was leaked online.

The Mass Effect community was hit hard this week by news that EA is closing down BioWare , the 30-year-old studio known for spearheading Western RPGs with series like Dragon Age, Mass Effect, Jade Empire, and others.

Rubbing salt in the wound, EA also revealed the next Mass Effect game (supposedly titled Mass Effect Universe) was canceled. This revelation hurt even more after staff who formerly worked on the project spoke out about it online , with one even leaking a full-length trailer for the game on Reddit. This trailer promised a game that would have been everything fans wanted and more — and it even caught the attention of FemShep herself.
Hale responded to a re-upload of the Mass Effect 5 trailer on X/Twitter, and it seems she’s just as hopeful as the rest of us that somehow, some way, the game will still get made.
“It's extraordinary,” she wrote . “I’m holding hope for magic to happen. This community and you incredible devs deserve that and more.”

Two days prior, she went live on Instagram alongside fellow Commander Shepard voice actor Mark Meer, who plays the male version of the character, to address fans in the wake of EA’s devastating decision

“I feel weirdly hopeful, and I can’t explain why,” Hale said. “...I feel for the [BioWare] employees who are suddenly unemployed. That is the number one thing on my mind. Those beautiful team members who are looking for a new home.”

“It is very sad news,” Meer added. “It is a massive loss for Edmonton, for Canada, and for the video game industry in general. It’s very unfortunate to see. And of course, I feel very bad for all of the fans.”

“It’s really hard to think about BioWare being shut down, but it was in the hands of ownership that may not have understood what BioWare fully is,” Hale continued. “And I’m hopeful that maybe, there might be some crazy thing where they decide that. in order to increase their profit margins — which is often their priority — they will release these IPs into the market to sell them, and use that to do what they do, which is increase their profit margins. But maybe, someone could grab hold of these IPs and do something with them.”

Hale isn’t alone in this line of thinking; many fans are calling on EA to at least sell BioWare’s intellectual properties to other developers in the hopes that Mass Effect 5 can eventually be released. Even Canadian politicians are getting in on the conversation, with the country’s New Democratic Party leader Avi Lewis taking to social media to publicly call out EA.

However, industry insiders and analysts are urging caution around this particular idea. Speaking with IGN, three separate analysts stated that BioWare’s library of titles simply don’t align with EA’s current strategy, and said it’s unlikely the company relinquishes them to other companies. What’s more, these IPs are likely to be extremely expensive, to the point where other studios simply wouldn’t have the funds nor the time to pursue them.

Former BioWare executive producer Mark Darrah shared a similar sentiment , though he admitted that, given EA is now looking to cut costs to cover its massive debt, it might consider the idea of selling these IPs off — but said it’s just as likely that execs “just try to forget that they ever existed and bury them in the vault.”

Magic: The Gathering’s crossovers tend to draw a mixed response from the hardcore fans who want more of Jace, Liliana, and Gideon over the Avengers, but if there’s one crossover that’s been universally praised, it was Lord of the Rings.

Wizards of the Coast looked to follow suit this year with a return to Middle-Earth, and while The Hobbit offers a smaller set than the 2023 original, it’s still packed with great cards. This Hobbit x Magic Deal Is Likely To Get Better

others.title: 泄露的《质量效应 5》预告片是真实的，让我们一睹被取消的游戏的风采

content.v: Prolific and veteran gaming actor Jennifer Hale, who is known for voicing Commander Shepard in the Mass Effect series, has reacted to the closure of BioWare and the cancellation of the next game in the series. After footage of the new project, Mass Effect Universe , was released, Hale said , "It's extraordinary."
She added: "I’m holding hope for magic to happen. This community and you incredible vevs deserve that and more."

A "Save Mass Effect" Change.org petition was launched this week to urge EA to "take decisive action by committing to the continued development of Mass Effect." The petition has more than 65,000 signatures so far.

All of BioWare's new releases in the past decade--Mass Effect: Andromeda, Anthem, and Dragon Age: The Veilguard--were commercial disappointments. Against that backdrop, closing the studio makes a lot of financial sense , but it's upsetting to the millions of Mass Effect fans who adore the franchise and want to see it continue.
Based on insider reporting, the new Mass Effect game would have mixed covert ops with John Wick-inspired action , and that got a lot of people excited about what could have been.

Composer Bear McCreary, who has done work for the God of War and Call of Duty franchises, reacted to BioWare's closure, too . Asked if the laid-off BioWare developers could take what they had and complete the project as a "spiritual successor" via crowdfunding, McCreary said it's a good idea but is probably unrealistic.
"Man, I want to believe. But, I just gotta ask... How many examples are there of this really working in the past? And of those examples, how many were a project as big as Mass Effect?" he said.
Avi Lewis, a Canadian politician, has called on the government to help save BioWare by providing “federal support” to the workers to buy it back.

“This is private equity, this is what it does,” he said. “Buy up businesses, run them into the ground, and rip them apart for short-term profit. The developers at BioWare know how to run the studio. They know how to make the games we all love. They should be given the first opportunity–and the federal support–to buy it and run it themselves.”
The new Mass Effect game was revealed in 2020 . Since then, the game remained in “early development” until its cancellation this week.
While the new Mass Effect game is not going ahead, the Mass Effect TV show for Prime Video remains in development .

The closure of BioWare and cancellation of the new Mass Effect game came as part of a wider shakeup at EA following its sale to an investor consortium including Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners. EA cut jobs, canceled games, and scaled back in other ways as part of the shakeup, as the publisher faces a huge debt repayment schedule.
